messages:
Jordan: quick follow-up from the runtime segment at the all-hands. dumping short Qs so we can action.

Kim: first: whats the conservative canary cadence for kernel updates? small steps?

Jordan: conservative: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 12-24h holds. adjust if we see noise.

Priya: what metrics will immediately trigger an abort (hard stop)?

Jordan: hard aborts = p99 > 2x baseline OR token error-rate > 3x OR OOM spikes. soft alerts for p95 > 1.25x, kv hit-rate drop > 15%.

Ethan: batching question  any change to default max_batch_delay for chat-heavy routes?

Jordan: default stays 10ms for chat routes, but autotune will lower delay where it sees steady streams. route overrides will be available.

Kim: cache TTLs  are we exposing adaptive-cache per-route or global?

Priya: plan: opt-in per-route flag "adaptive_cache": true. default TTL remains 30s until GA signals look good.

Ethan: SRE asks for a small canary YAML they can paste into monitors.

Jordan: paste below:

```
canary:
  steps:
    - pct: 1
      hold: 12h
    - pct: 5
      hold: 24h
    - pct: 20
      hold: 24h
signals:
  latency:
    p95_multiplier: 1.2
  errors:
    multiplier: 2.0
  kv:
    hit_rate_drop: 0.15
```

DeployBot: rollout-controller: created experiment/kernel-v2-autotune at 1823456835 :rocket:

Jordan: thanks all. Priya and I will draft a 3-bullet release note and a deep-dive doc. Will post links when ready. If anyone sees odd telemetry after rollout starts, drop screenshots here.
